ledger.currency: All ledger rows are kept in the base currency (minor units).
ledger.nulls: Missing references are explicit null; never infer links that are not recorded.
ledger.timestamp: Ledger timestamp of a document posting equals the document timestamp (same instant).

period.basis: An invoice belongs to the period of its issued_at instant, a payment to the period of its timestamp, both judged in the company timezone. Only in-period documents may be posted.

fx.rate_meaning: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency (major units)
fx.rate_date: Local calendar date (company timezone) of the document timestamp; if no rate exists for that date use the most recent earlier date in fx.csv.
fx.invoice_posting: AR debit and revenue credit = convert(total_minor, rate at invoice date).
fx.payment_posting: Cash debit = convert(amount_minor, rate at payment date); AR credit per applied invoice = convert(applied_minor, rate at that invoice's date); unapplied remainder to 2300 at the payment-date rate; any difference to 7900.
fx.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP to the base minor unit, per posting line.

allocation: A receipt's invoice_refs are the authoritative allocation. A refund debits 2300.
duplicates: Two invoices of the same entity with the same po_ref and identical line items (sku, quantity, unit price, service_period) are duplicates. Equal totals alone are not. An invoice posted twice to AR is also a duplicate.

amount.duplicate_invoice: AR debit of the duplicate posting
amount.payment_allocation: expected AR credit for the (payment, invoice) pair minus the booked AR credit
amount.fx_conversion: |booked - correct| of the primary line (AR debit for invoices, cash debit for payments)
amount.period_cutoff: booked primary line (AR debit for invoices, cash debit for payments)

affected_ids.duplicate_invoice: both invoice_ids (duplicate document) or the single invoice_id (double posting)

evidence.duplicate_invoice: both doc_ids + one ledger row of the duplicate posting; or doc_id + both AR (or both revenue) rows for a double posting
evidence.payment_allocation: payment doc_id + invoice doc_id + one row of the payment's posting (cash, 2300, or AR row it credited) + fx_id of the invoice-date rate if the invoice is not in base currency
evidence.fx_conversion: doc_id + primary ledger row (AR or revenue / cash) + fx_id of the correct rate
evidence.period_cutoff: doc_id + primary ledger row (AR or revenue / cash)

findings.evidence_aliases: invoice_id / payment_id given as evidence are normalised to their doc_id
